My consulting [work](/thoughts/craft) is in [machine learning](/thoughts/Machine-learning) systems and efficient inference engines. I also study [model behaviour](/research). This [website](/index) is the non-physical me, my notes, and my interests. There is also a [latent](/embeddings) exploration of this site. I mainly work on open source, and I plan to keep doing so. As of 2026-11-01, it has 1,626,653 [words](/thoughts/), counted by [this script](/thoughts/scripts/calculate_tokens.py).

I focus on kernel optimization for LLM inference and on deployments where latency and throughput are measured end to end. I offer the following services:

- custom prefill and decode kernels for latency-sensitive or high-throughput LLM deployments
- distributed LLM serving, including NCCL setup and debugging

If you would like to work with me, contact me at [services@aarnphm.xyz](mailto:services@aarnphm.xyz).
